title: Region event
description: An agent adds a region (a container) or updates one by its id. The board comes from the path when sent.

region.description: The container to add, or to update when its id already exists.

by.description: Who wrote the line; always `agent` for this event.

board.description: The board the line belongs to; the server takes it from the path.

noList.description: From ledger v12 a container's mode is never `list`: it was renamed `column`.
noList.$comment: Kept apart from `region` so a stored line from v11 or older, which may name `list`, still reads. Was: api.md 129

region.description: The container, whose mode is never `list`.

rules.description: A stored line from v12 on names no `list` mode.
rules.$comment: Kept apart from `core` so a failed rule never hides which fields are known (see common.schema.json `stampAgent`). Was: api.md 129

id.description: The container's id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Send an id that already exists to update that container.

title.description: The container's title, shown on the board.

mode.description: How the container lays out its cards: `grid`, `flow` (follows the links), `lanes`, `radial`, `column` (top to bottom in card order) or `row` (left to right in card order). `list`, on lines from ledger v11 and older only, reads as `column`.

lanes.description: Lane names, top to bottom. Required when the mode is `lanes`.

center.description: The centre card: its number on this board when sent, its ledger number on a stored line

columns.description: How many columns a `grid` container uses, from 1 to 12.

widths.description: How wide the cards are: `match` (every card in a column as wide as its widest) or `own` (each card its own width). Left out, the mode decides: `match` for `grid` and `column`, `own` for the rest. The person's choice wins.
